description: Data teams need to catch when timestamp columns silently shift formats, time zones, or null patterns between file drops.

current_csv_sample.description: Must contain CSV text with a header row. Empty input is invalid.

datetime_columns.description: Comma-separated column names or one column name per line. Each declared column must exist in both CSV headers after optional trimming is applied.

previous_csv_sample.description: Must contain CSV text with a header row. Empty input is invalid.

strict_mode.description: When true, any detected ambiguity, mixed format column, or unparseable value in a declared datetime column upgrades the ingestion risk to high.

name: csv-date-and-time-format-drift-checker
title: CSV Date and Time Format Drift Checker
